description: Client-side script managing a modal image/file manager interface, including file upload, folder creation, deletion, navigation, and integration with CKEditor.

methods.name: loadFileManager
methods.description: Handles loading file list into modal body based on user interactions.

methods.name: uploadFile
methods.description: Handles file upload process including size validation and AJAX upload.

methods.name: createFolder
methods.description: Creates a new folder via AJAX request.

methods.name: deleteFiles
methods.description: Deletes selected files or folders via AJAX request.

methods.name: navigateFolder
methods.description: Handles folder navigation when clicking directory links.

methods.name: selectThumbnail
methods.description: Inserts selected image into CKEditor or updates target element.
